Is 2.1 a pass or fail responsibility requirement, or is it evaluated as part of the past performance factor described in the evaluation criteria? b. Where an offeror's relevant past performance was performed under commercial contracts rather than federal prime contracts, will the Government accept that commercial past performance? Will the Government also accept the relevant past performance of proposed key personnel or of a proposed subcontractor? Answer: Paragraph 2.1 is evaluated as part of the Government’s technical assessment of the offeror’s relevant past performance and technical competency, rather than as a separate pass/fail responsibility determination. The Government will accept relevant commercial past performance, not just federal prime contract experience, provided the quoted experience demonstrates comparable scope, complexity, and relevance to the requirement. This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. The Land Bank is wholly - owned by the South African government, and is in turn the sole shareholder of LBIC and LBLIC, which provide insurance products in the agricultural sector. The Bank’s objectives flow from the Land Bank Act, No. 15 of 2002, and are aligned with government policies and the country’s socio -economic needs. The National Institutes of Health (NIH), Office of the Director, Office of Acquisitions, intends to negotiate and award a ﬁrm-ﬁxed-price purchase order on a non-competitive basis to Xact Metal, Inc., 200 Innovation Blvd, Ste 257, State College, PA 16803 for one (1) Advanced Metal Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) 3D Printing System, including required software, accessories, installation, and on-site operator training, in support of the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI), Division of Intramural Research. Market research conducted in accordance with FAR Part 10 concluded that the Xact Metal XM200-series LPBF platform is the only commercially available system that simultaneously satisﬁes all of the Government's mandatory salient characteristics — including qualiﬁed processing of titanium alloys, copper, and stainless steel on a single multi-material platform; feature precision of 50 microns or ﬁner; an integrated glovebox for safe handling of reactive metal powders; single-phase 100–240 VAC laboratory power compatibi

monly used engineering metals; • Multi-material capability supporting a range of metal powders without fundamental system modiﬁcation; • Integrated system for safe handling of reactive metal powders, including titanium, through an enclosed or controlled environment (e.g., glovebox or equivalent); • Compact footprint suitable for installation and operation within a biomedical research laboratory; • Compatibility with standard single-phase laboratory electrical infrastructure (100– 240 VAC, 50–60 Hz); • Inclusion of all required software, accessories, and operational components necessary for full system functionality; • Provision of on-site installation and operator training. The system shall be delivered, installed, and made fully operational within sixty (60) days after contract award. Konfidentsiaalsuskohustus ei kehti teabele, mis on avalikkusele kättesaadav ATL-i sõlmimise hetkel ning mille avaldamiseks on olemas teise poole kirjalik nõusolek või mille avaldamise kohustustus tuleneb seadusest. ATL-is sätestatud konfidentsiaalsuskohustus jääb kehtima ka pärast ATL lõppemist. Volitatud töötleja kohustub tagama, et isikutega, kes on volitatud töötlema isikuandmeid, on sõlmitud kirjalikud konfidentsiaalsuslepingud (sealhulgas, mis kehtivad pärast töösuhte või muu õigussuhte lõppu). Tehnilised ja korralduslikud turvameetmed Volitatud töötleja võtab kasutusele kõik abinõud, et vältida isikuandmete sattumist kolmandate, selleks õigust mitteomavate isikute, valdusesse. Volitatud töötleja on kohustatud kehtestama sellised asjakohased tehnilised ja korralduslikud meetmed, mis kaitsevad isikuandmeid hävimise, muutmise, loata avaldamise, loata juurdepääsu ja loata töötlemise eest, samas vastavad seaduse nõuetele ning tagavad andmesubjektide õiguste kaitse. Vajadusel annab vastutav töötleja volitatud töötlejale turvameetmetega seotud mõistlikke lisajuhiseid. Sellisteks meetmeteks on näiteks: isikuandmete pseudonümiseerimine ja/või krüpteerimine; võime tagada isikuandmeid töötlevate süsteemide ja teenuste kestev konfidentsiaalsus, terviklikkus, kättesaadavus ja

)asutus või kolmas isik nõuab volitatud töötlejalt teavet seoses isikuandmete töötlemisega, edastab volitatud töötleja päringu vastutavale töötlejale.
